One important home-backup consideration

These are portable power stations, not whole-house generators. A roughly 2 kWh unit can keep selected essentials running, but actual runtime depends on appliance consumption, inverter losses, and starting surges. Running central air conditioning, electric water heating, or an entire home is generally outside their intended capacity.

My recommendation: Spend around $900 on the BLUETTI Elite 200 V2 for maximum capacity, or choose the Anker SOLIX C2000 Gen 2 if expanding your backup system later matters more.
